g.text: Differences between GOLD and BRONZE sites, set-B tiers, 95% gene-cluster intervals (1,000 resamples) unless marked. Dotted vertical line: primary P-all estimate; solid
grey vertical line: no difference. Primary row, GOLD / BRONZE sites and gene clusters. No two-way interval is stored for P-human, so that marker is absent. Within-gene
rows use the linear within-gene difference (S/T/Y records). The P-abund block (human proteins with an abundance value) shows the crude estimate and the adjusted
designs with the stored protein-cluster intervals. A: conservation 93,308 / 37,591 sites, 17,777 gene clusters (P-human 49,939 / 17,477, 7,965) B: disorder 320,780 /
